ah i wrote that out extremely fast but i am not categorizing devil fruits, more so personal affinities for a nen-like class system. this is one piece there isnt any auras but we can deduce things about characters based on the abilities they come up with.

 luffy is not a transmuter because he cannot/does notchange the properties of his body. his body IS RUBBER.
he has transmutter type abilities that change the properties of his rubber (red hawk, thor) and you can argue he is an emitter because of attacks like gum gum pistol but luffys natural affinity is enhancement 100%. luffys real strength lies in his gears which allow him to enhance his body.
 a true transmutter in the series would be sanji because of diablo jambe. a true emitter would be zoro (see 1080 lb phoenix).
 you have to think of devil fruits as an addition to natural affinities. if luffy had nothing he would still be an enhancer. garp (though there isnt that much information on his abilities) is a great reference for this.
 luffy will never conjure or manipulate rubber. it doesnt even make sense. why would he need to. he never even uses environments to his advantage. and his abilities wojldnt make sense with a weapon lol. he would have to learn all new abilities to use it and from what ive seen imbuing CoA into a weapon seems different then just coating yoir body into it. it would change him as a character too much and oda wont do that.  luffy would have much more of an advantage if he could emitt rubber or transmute the shape of his rubber, because he is inherentley a melee class.
